reason: Adopt openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#75: framework-owned authorization, so HyperShell's RBAC is one authz.Authorizer that TRex applies to every declared REST route and gRPC method (SEC-RBAC-24). This also includes #72 (login issuer discovery), #73 and #76 (removed API client and its flags). The module has no release tags. Remove this age exception after 2026-11-20 or when a newer pin replaces it.

Upstream tests cover the framework's REST and gRPC authorization chain.
